final: WITH pats AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-'), per AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN pats p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_pt_avgs, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_diff_avgs FROM per
